item.title: Death Valley National Park to mark Timbisha Shoshone Act anniversary with public celebration
item.description: LAS VEGAS (KLAS) -- The anniversary of a tribe's ancestral ties to Death Valley will be celebrated on January 30. Death Valley National Park, in partnership with the Timbisha Shoshone Tribe, will celebrate the 25th anniversary of the Timbisha Shoshone Homeland Act with a public event recognizing a landmark moment in tribal sovereignty and park co-management. item.title: Las Vegas saw 38.5M visitors in 2025; dropping 7.5% from 2024
item.description: Las Vegas welcomed 38.5 million visitors in 2025, marking a 7.5% decrease compared to 2024, according to data from the Las Vegas Convention and Visitors Authority.
